description: This file is a script written in JavaScript with ECMAScript modules syntax; it analyzes TypeScript source files within a repository to detect specific architecture 'smells' or anti-patterns related to plugin SDKs, runtime types, and service locators.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Compares two entries for sorting based on category, file, line, kind, specifier, and reason.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Inserts an entry into the entries array.

methods.name: scanPluginSdkExtensionFacadeSmells
methods.description: Detects extension facade re-exports in plugin SDK source files that re-export implementation modules.

methods.name: scanRuntimeTypeImplementationSmells
methods.description: Checks for direct references to implementation shim files in runtime type files.

methods.name: scanRuntimeServiceLocatorSmells
methods.description: Detects patterns related to runtime service locator usage, including creation and mutable state in source files.

methods.name: collectArchitectureSmells
methods.description: Aggregates architecture smell entries from relevant source files in the project.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the collected inventory of smells into a human-readable string.

methods.name: runArchitectureSmellsCheck
methods.description: Main function to run the architecture smells check, optionally outputting JSON or human-readable report.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that runs the architecture smells check.
